title: Ntawntawdi Aba
intro: Ansa na wiase no rehu sɛ ntawntawdi atrɛw no, gyidi ne osetie ho sɔhwɛ a emu dɔ bi daa adi. Saa asɛm yi hwehwɛ nneɛma a ankorankoro bi paw, a ne nneyɛe yɛ nhwɛso ma awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba daakye no mu. Siesie wo ho sɛ wobɛpae ɔkra bi a ɔrepere ahoɔyaw kɛse ne nea efi mu ba a ɛyɛ hu ho asɛm no mu.
clues: Ná meka mma a wodii kan nantew asase so no ho, na na meyɛ adesamma baanu a wodi kan koraa no ba.
Wɔhyɛɛ me ne me nua sɛ yɛmmɔ afɔre mma Allah, a ɛyɛ yɛn nokwaredi ho sɔhwɛ.
Wɔannye m’afɔrebɔ no antom, bere a wɔannye me nua de no, na ɛno maa nkate a ɛyɛ hu hyɛɛ me koma ma.
Mekaa ahunahuna nsɛm kyerɛɛ me nuabarima, a pow a ɛyɛ yaw no na ɛkanyan me.
Me nua no de nyansa ne nyamesom pa buaa me, na ɔkaee me Allah atɛntrenee ne Ne suro.
Ɛmfa ho sɛ me nuabarima no kaa nsɛm brɛoo ne ɔpɛ a na ɔwɔ sɛ ɔde bɔne firi no, migyee nkwa, na mebɛyɛɛ wɔn a wɔhweree no no mu biako.

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
